method: BLEU/ROUGE and optional MiniLM cosine against a public-only reference-assisted draft; not semantic accuracy.

metric_definition.bleu: Existing add-one-smoothed BLEU-4; macro sentence mean plus corpus BLEU
metric_definition.rouge: Mean sentence ROUGE-1/2/L F1; existing ASCII word tokenizer
metric_definition.missing_or_unknown_only: Zero per-line scores, retained in scorable-reference denominator
metric_definition.unknown_reference: Confidence unknown or wholly unknown English: unscorable, explicitly counted
metric_definition.unknown_detection: Lexical marker heuristic; partial unknown answers remain scored; explicit whole-content abstentions additionally normalized by the audited extraction adapter
metric_definition.cosine: Paired MiniLM cosine; absent/wholly unknown hypotheses receive zero
